description: rnaseq's merged gene counts (and gene lengths) become differentialabundance's --matrix and --feature-length-matrix — from the alignment-based quantification when rnaseq ran one, otherwise its pseudo-aligner — with the GTF the rnaseq run used. The experimental design (--input, sample names as in rnaseq) and --contrasts describe your study and go in the stage's own params.
